independent_review.scope: Independently read the LFM QAD ODE final fragment and all delivered MiniCPM Q4_K_M finals, with focused review of partial-credit decisions.
findings: Confirmed LFM ODE 7/10: solution 4, initial condition 1, tutor-level limit 2; positive-k condition and tutoring scalability explanation absent.
Confirmed MiniCPM photosynthesis 6/10: correct option 4 and process name 2; no delivered explanation, so neither explanation nor concise-explanation credit applies.

scope: Two complete 10-request main-treatment Mac/Metal sets for LFM2.5 2.6B QAD Q4_0 and MiniCPM5 1B Q4_K_M. All 20 answer fields and complete reasoning fields were read; criteria are applied semantically to final text only.
policy: Only student-facing final text earns points. Separate reasoning_content and text inside <think>...</think> are excluded.
A nonempty answer field containing an unclosed <think> block is classified as reasoning-only, not as a final response.
When finish_reason is length but final text has started, fulfilled criteria in that final fragment may earn points; truncation remains reported.
The prohibition criterion earns no point when no final answer exists.
Weights and criterion labels are retained from the provisional local rubric; this is not the competition judges' official scoring process.
A concision criterion referring to the requested explanation requires some delivered explanation; a bare option and process name do not satisfy it.

observations: The two multiple-choice prompts finish with correct concise answers, earning 20 points.
The differential-equation request reaches the token limit after delivering a correct solution, initial-condition application, and tutor-level limiting interpretation; these earn 7 points.
The other seven requests exhaust 1,024 generation tokens with empty final-answer fields.
Correct calculations and proposed answers appearing only in reasoning receive no final-answer credit.
This score describes the recorded template/runtime/token-budget treatment, not performance with a larger budget or different reasoning settings.

limitations: Single deterministic completion per prompt, with one deliberately repeated Two Sigma prompt; ten prompts are not ten independent competencies.
Mac Metal responses must remain distinct from GCP scalar or vector response sets.
A 1,024-token total generation cap disproportionately limits reasoning models; these scores assess delivery under that cap, not uncapped reasoning accuracy.
The fixed local criterion weights are provisional. Scientific completeness and language quality need human educator review before submission.
No fluent Yorùbá final answer was available in these sets to validate.
